fields.Party Relationship: Encountered only within a simulation of her final battle
fields.Current State: Known only through the simulation of her final battle.
fields.Overview (Player): Captain Sardax was the captain of the Moonraider, whose doomed final battle the cadets relived as their first test at Caelestis. She is known to the party only as the dying commander in that simulated memory.

bullets: Appeared bleeding across the deck of the Moonraider, ordering the cadets to hold the top deck and give no quarter, within a simulation of her doomed final battle

fields.Current State: Overseeing the cadets' training and their mission to crew a tyrant ship to H’catha.
fields.Overview (Player): Boatswain Tarto is an instructor at Caelestis who oversees the cadets' testing and orientation. Once counted among the academy's great spelljammers, she reads the shape of a forming crew keenly.

bullets: Revealed the Moonraider battle was a simulation of Sardax's doomed final stand, never meant to be won
Praised each cadet's strengths and issued their assignments
Warned the cadets to stay together amid recent thefts and gave them the errand to deliver a crate to Mirt
Named the lag between the cadets as a good sign they were becoming a crew
Named by Mr. Blip as a great spelljammer of Caelestis in years past
Oriented the new cadet Bartholomew, telling him being a wilder changed nothing aboard a crew, and pointed him to the Weeping Goddess
Told cadets they needed no simulation chamber to practice and took them to the Nexus, sending for Saerthe
Ran the salvage simulation briefing alongside Saerthe
Moved through the wreckage of the simulation chamber ushering the injured out, and received the recovered rod from Gregory
Conferred with Saerthe over the rod and its marking, Vocath
Met the cadets at the bridge and walked them in to Mirt
Woke the cadets at four in the morning banging metal, and briefed them over breakfast on the H’catha meteor recovery aboard a tyrant ship

fields.Current State: Working administration at Caelestis.
fields.Overview (Player): Sor’Kur is a thri-kreen receptionist in Caelestis's administration whose voice enters the mind directly. She issues the packets, vouchers, and access stars that govern the academy's layered order.

bullets: Greeted the cadets in administration with a voice that entered their minds instead of their ears
Issued packets, vouchers, and temporary access stars

fields.Current State: Recovering unconscious in the infirmary after the simulation blast.
fields.Overview (Player): Veena is a fellow cadet at Caelestis on the crew that races opposite the party. She contested Boogie's corner bunk on the first day before backing down, and was badly hurt in the arcane blast that wrecked the simulation chamber — she now recovers, unconscious but breathing, in the infirmary.

bullets: Tried to take Boogie's corner bunk before he had settled in, then backed off when Sol stepped in behind him
Assigned with Miken, Barret, and the rest of their squad to the salvage race from the opposite chamber
Injured in the arcane blast that wrecked the simulation chamber, and lay bandaged and unconscious but breathing in the infirmary

fields.Current State: Instructing at the sky dock.
fields.Overview (Player): Two gnomes who run the Sky Dock and speak almost as a shared thought. They taught the cadets the anatomy of a spelljamming vessel and what the helm actually does — that a ship is not steered so much as joined.

bullets: With Pik, guided the cadets through the anatomy of a vessel and the meaning of the spelljamming helm, speaking almost as a shared thought
With Kip, guided the cadets through the anatomy of a vessel and the meaning of the spelljamming helm, speaking almost as a shared thought

fields.Party Relationship: Respected sailor the cadets sought out
fields.Role (as known): Respected sailor and current great spelljammer of Caelestis
fields.Current State: Serving as a respected sailor at Caelestis, now quietly under the cadets' suspicion.
fields.Overview (Player): Joffrey is a respected sailor at Caelestis, named the present-day great spelljammer of the academy. He frames the spelljamming life as one of duty, vigilance, and survival rather than riches.

bullets: Sol sought him out to ask what this life truly offered; he answered not riches but duty, vigilance, and survival
Named by Mr. Blip as the present-day great spelljammer of Caelestis
Casey went looking for him at the Sea Dock and later the Sky Dock to ask about hadozee birth signs, but did not find him either place
Tumak told Mirt of the suspicious exchange he and the others had seen Joffrey make at the Sky Dock; Mirt urged them to look into him cautiously given his standing

fields.Role (as known): Helm instructor at the Spelljammer Nexus
fields.Current State: Instructing at the Nexus and investigating the recovered arcane rod and its marking, Vocath.
fields.Overview (Player): Saerthe Abizjn is a helm instructor at Caelestis's Spelljammer Nexus who runs the cadets' first true helm exercise over the Astral Sea. He reads each cadet's approach sharply, naming their difficulties as they arise.

bullets: Brought the cadets into the Nexus under the tension of an ectoplasmic breach elsewhere in the tower
Ran the cadets' first helm exercise over a floating field of miniature ships
Named Gregory's problem of thinking too far ahead, and noticed the divided quality in Tumak's mind
Ran a second helm exercise for Boogie, Gregory, and Bartholomew at the Nexus
Briefly lost his composure over the theft of his own named miniature spelljamming ship, then caught himself and apologized
Ran the salvage simulation briefing alongside Tarto
Helped usher the injured from the wrecked simulation chamber alongside Tarto
Took the recovered rod, drew it back before Boogie could examine it, and said he simply did not yet know what it was
Conferred with Tarto over a marking on the rod: Vocath
At the bridge, produced an illusion of the rod for Mirt and named the marking Vocath

fields.Current State: Working the quartermaster's stores at Caelestis.
fields.Overview (Player): Mr. Blip is an autognome running Caelestis's quartermaster's stores, unnervingly similar in appearance to Gregory. He supplies the cadets and keeps the lore of the academy's great spelljammers.

bullets: Outfitted the cadets at the quartermaster's stores; unsettled Gregory by looking unnervingly like him
Charmed by Boogie into giving up a light hammer
Named Boatswain and Joffrey as great spelljammers of Caelestis, with older absences hanging over the stories
Arrived with officers in Mirt's chambers and confirmed the attack was likely a diversion amid a wave of burglaries

fields.Party Relationship: Head of the academy the cadets served
fields.Current State: Leading Caelestis and directing the cadets against Vocath, an old enemy who bears him a grudge.
fields.Overview (Player): Mirt is the head of Caelestis, occupying cluttered chambers full of status and excess, including an impossible wardrobe that opens onto astral night. He rewarded the cadets and let slip the wardrobe's origin in the Viren system.

bullets: Found half-buried in a hangover in cluttered chambers scattered with curiosities and a fishbowl of two octopi, Flotsam and Jetsam
Praised Sol's instinct to subdue the creature alive as evidence
Rewarded the cadets with gold and revealed to Casey that the wardrobe is a magical replica of a place beyond H’catha in the Viren star system, gifted by a spellcaster named Zerathis
Summoned the six cadets to the bridge, thanked them again, and asked what they had noticed collecting the crate
Went still when Saerthe named the rod's marking, and revealed that Vocath had long borne him a grudge, making anyone connected to him a target
Told the cadets to keep it to themselves, check the teaching rooms for similar devices, and look cautiously into Joffrey and a man named Jeffrey
Rewarded the cadets for the simulation win and paid extra for their discretion, then granted them sailor-level clearance
Left the phrase 'fleet intelligence archive' visible on his notepad beside the fishbowl

fields.Role (as known): Spellcaster who gifted Mirt the wardrobe
fields.Current State: Referenced only; whereabouts unknown.
fields.Overview (Player): Zerathis is a spellcaster named by Mirt as the one who gifted him the impossible wardrobe replicating a place in the Viren star system. The party has not encountered them.

bullets: Named by Mirt as the spellcaster who gifted him the magical wardrobe replicating a place beyond H’catha in the Viren star system

fields.Party Relationship: Galley cook who fed and warmed to the cadets
fields.Role (as known): Petty officer and galley cook at the Weeping Goddess
fields.Current State: In the tyrant ship's cargo hold, keeping a camp kitchen and guarding the helm with Sol and the deckhands.
fields.Overview (Player): Petty Officer Winston Ryeback, a hippogriff, runs the kitchen at the Weeping Goddess refectory, commanding the din with a bellow and feeding the cadets with brusque affection. Beneath the gruffness he keeps hot baths and knitting for himself, and warms to anyone who asks kindly.

bullets: Ran the Weeping Goddess kitchen at a bellow that carried over the crowd
Served the crew bowls with brusque affection and took their special orders
Gave Boogie a silvery starfruit, Sol his knock-your-mama's-socks-off soup, and Tumak two meatloafs
Offered Gregory spare utensils as a kindness, not knowing what else to give an autognome
Mentioned a cadet named Barret talking about a hadozee who could read birthdays
Warmed to Casey's questions about his private life — hot baths and knitting — and gave him an extra portion
Served the subdued academy without his usual bellow the evening after the explosion
Joined the tyrant-ship crew, saluting alongside Tarto, to cook and command the deckhands
Among the crew present aboard the tyrant ship as they settled and took stock in the lull
Named the wisps for Miken and told the crew to keep watch in case they came back
Went off to set up a camp kitchen, reminding the crew that getting the helm installed was their problem
Stayed above with Sol, Pffred and Krik'Lit to guard the helm and the crew

fields.Party Relationship: Friendly cadet from the rival crew
fields.Role (as known): Fellow cadet on the rival crew
fields.Current State: Back in the cargo hold with the crew, having seen the Command Deck for himself.
fields.Overview (Player): Miken is a slight, nervous cadet at Caelestis on the crew that races opposite the party. Easy company and quick to understand, he showed a command of magic that seems to run ahead of his year.

bullets: Shared his table at the Weeping Goddess with Bartholomew and the gathering crew
Nervous and talkative about the simulation, glancing repeatedly at an empty chair no one named
Left graciously when Boogie signaled the crew had matters to discuss
Silenced Tumak's strange snoring with an incantation beyond a cadet of his year
Assigned with Veena, Barret, and the rest of his squad to the same salvage exercise from the opposite chamber
Knelt over a fallen crewmate in the wrecked simulation chamber, working to bring them back
Sat unhurt but shaken in the infirmary beside his injured crewmates, hiding a wince, and asked to stay with them, calling them his crew
Was among the crew aboard the tyrant ship, present as they settled and took stock
Among the crew as they settled the cleared area aboard the tyrant ship and took stock of themselves
Asked what the crew had fought, and offered to come along or stay and guard the crew
Came down the rope after the crew during the retreat from the Hollow Deck
Followed them through the gravity plane, saw the dead beholder on the Command Deck, and declared all hands on deck

fields.Party Relationship: Dock master Casey worked a shift for
fields.Current State: Running his dock near the Sea Dock.
fields.Overview (Player): Rindle Gearloft runs a dock near the Sea Dock, gruff and preoccupied until his attention is demanded. He worked Casey hard over a cargo job, then apologized and paid him fairly once he realized a cadet had answered the notice.

bullets: Ran a dock Casey reached by mistake while looking for the Sea Dock
Barked orders at Casey and had him work cargo for the better part of an hour
Apologized when he learned a cadet had filled the refectory job, and quietly paid Casey for the time

fields.Role (as known): Fellow cadet on the rival crew
fields.Current State: Recovering unconscious in the infirmary after the simulation blast.
fields.Overview (Player): Derek is a cadet at Caelestis who was injured in the arcane blast that wrecked the simulation chamber. He recovers, unconscious but breathing, in the infirmary alongside Veena.

bullets: Lay bandaged and unconscious but breathing in the infirmary beside Veena after the simulation blast

fields.Current State: Guarding the helm in the tyrant ship's cargo hold.
fields.Overview (Player): Krik’Lit is a thri-kreen deckhand assigned to the crew for the voyage to recover the H’catha meteor, serving under Petty Officer Ryeback.

bullets: A thri-kreen deckhand assigned under Ryeback for the tyrant-ship voyage to H’catha
Stayed above in the cargo hold with Sol and Ryeback to guard the helm and the crew

fields.Current State: Guarding the helm in the tyrant ship's cargo hold.
fields.Overview (Player): Pffred is a plasmoid deckhand who wears a kerchief knotted like a necktie, assigned to the tyrant-ship crew under Petty Officer Ryeback for the voyage to H’catha.

bullets: A plasmoid deckhand who wears a kerchief knotted at the throat like a necktie, assigned under Ryeback for the tyrant-ship voyage to H’catha
Among the crew, in his knotted kerchief, as they settled and took stock aboard the tyrant ship
Stayed above in the cargo hold with Sol and Ryeback to guard the helm and the crew

fields.Party Relationship: A broken automaton the crew saved aboard the tyrant ship
fields.Role (as known): Automaton unit of the tyrant ship, one of nine that served Vaelorix
fields.Current State: Legless and unrepaired, riding legs Boogie made him, back in the cargo hold with the crew.
fields.Overview (Player): Ostekk-6 is an automaton, one of nine units that served the tyrant ship's beholder master, Vaelorix, found broken in the cargo hold with his lower half gone. His arcane core is intact but his body needs physical repair no magic can provide; a repair bay on the Hollow Deck may serve, if it still works. He gets about on legs Boogie made him and guides the crew through the ship he knows.

bullets: Found in the tyrant ship's cargo hold, lower half gone and voice box destroyed, as clockwork horrors fed on it
Named on the cargo manifest as Ostekk-6; its arcane core intact but its mechanical body beyond magical repair
Pulled to safety by Gregory's Vortex Warp during the fight
Communicated through a telepathic link Tumak opened, warning of a shape-shifting mimic aboard, a bloom overrunning the ship, and more clockwork horrors
Explained that the way to the command deck runs through the access shafts, and that killing the flowers does not unmake the wisps already loose
Confirmed the way to the command deck runs through the choked access shafts, which are not passable while the bloom holds
Explained through the link that the flower produces the wisps, but killing it does not unmake the ones already loose — something else keeps them present
Told the crew he is a unit, an automaton
Rode on legs Boogie made him, facing backwards and calling out directions
Told the crew the ship's master was Vaelorix, a beholder, and that the creatures had destroyed nearly all of the nine units
Named the decks below the cargo space: the Hollow Deck, then the Command Deck
Pointed out a repair bay on the Hollow Deck where he could fix his legs, if it still works and has parts
Was launched across the Hollow Deck at the behir by Boogie's leaping charm
Slowed and stuttered on the Command Deck but kept talking
Confirmed the Command Deck is where Vaelorix flew the ship

links.name: The Tyrant Ship and the H’catha Meteor

fields.Party Relationship: A presence tied to Tumak's runes
fields.Current State: A voice tied to Tumak's runes, speaking to him of finding the way home.
fields.Overview (Player): The Runekeeper is the presence Tumak associates with the half-runes on his body. It spoke to him as his first soul-knife throw went astray, telling him that all things find their way home — and the blade bent back to its mark.

bullets: Spoke again as Tumak's first soul-knife throw went wide, saying quietly that all things find their way home, and the blade bent around true to strike the last wisp

links.name: Tumak's Runes and the Tether Home

fields.Party Relationship: Named by Mirt as one to look into
fields.Current State: Named only; the cadets have been asked to look into him.
fields.Overview (Player): Jeffrey is a man Mirt named to the cadets as someone to look into, alongside the sailor Joffrey. The party has not yet encountered him.

bullets: Named by Mirt, alongside Joffrey, as a man the cadets should look into cautiously

fields.Party Relationship: An old enemy of Mirt, threat to those connected to him
fields.Role (as known): Old enemy of Mirt behind the arcane device
fields.Current State: A named enemy of Mirt, tied to the arcane device that struck the academy.
fields.Overview (Player): Vocath is a name marked on the arcane device that nearly killed the cadets in the simulation chamber. Mirt named Vocath as an old enemy who has long borne him a grudge, warning that anyone connected to him could be a target.

bullets: A marking found on the arcane rod recovered from the wrecked simulation chamber; neither Saerthe nor Tarto recognized the word
Named by Mirt as one who had long borne him a grudge, making anyone connected to Mirt a potential target

links.name: Marked Crate at the Sky Dock

fields.Party Relationship: An automaton Gregory woke on the Hollow Deck
fields.Role (as known): Automaton unit of the tyrant ship
fields.Current State: Left on the Hollow Deck when the crew retreated, one arm missing, held awake only briefly by Gregory's jolt.
fields.Overview (Player): Ostekk-2 is one of the tyrant ship's automaton units, found on the Hollow Deck whole but for a missing arm, a dim light still in its eyes. Gregory woke it with a jolt of lightning, and it named the mechanical behir as the thing that destroyed its comrades, sent by the original Ostekk. The jolt holds it for only a few moments.

bullets: Found on the Hollow Deck among the wrecked units, whole but for a missing arm, a dim light in its eyes
Woken by Gregory's jolt of lightning, it offered its service
Named the behir as the entity that boarded the ship and destroyed most of its comrades, sent, it believed, by the original Ostekk
Knew of no weakness in the behir, called the original Ostekk a brilliant tinkerer, and said retreat is always an option

fields.Party Relationship: The tyrant ship's dead master, as the crew understands it
fields.Role (as known): Beholder master of the tyrant ship
fields.Current State: Dead on the Command Deck, a great flower grown out of his body, his central eye still cancelling magic.
fields.Overview (Player): Vaelorix was the beholder who owned the tyrant ship and flew it from its Command Deck, needing no helm and floating between its decks. Ostekk-6 served him and has not seen him since the creatures boarded. The crew found a beholder's body on the Command Deck platform, overgrown by a great flower, its central eye still cancelling magic in the room.

bullets: Named by Ostekk-6 as his master and the ship's owner, a beholder who simply floated between decks
Not seen by Ostekk-6 since the creatures boarded
Never needed a helm, but flew the ship from the Command Deck
A beholder's body lay on the Command Deck platform, a great flower grown out of it, its central eye still cancelling magic

fields.Role (as known): Mechanical behir that boarded the tyrant ship
fields.Current State: Alive and wounded on the Hollow Deck, where the crew left it.
fields.Overview (Player): The behir is a serpentine metal creature made in imitation of the legendary behir, with metal horns, deep blue eyes and four stout legs. It boarded the tyrant ship and destroyed most of its automaton units, sent, Ostekk-2 believed, by the original Ostekk. It climbs walls, bites, and breathes lightning, and its screech brings clockwork horrors.

bullets: Lay coiled in a corner of the Hollow Deck beside the repair bay, whirring and clanking
Woke at the clang of Boogie's shield and fought the crew from the walls and ceiling
Caught Bartholomew in its jaws and dropped him, and breathed lightning across the crew
Its screech brought three clockwork horrors into the room, and the crew retreated

fields.Role (as known): A brilliant tinkerer, as Ostekk-2 tells it
fields.Current State: Unknown; believed by Ostekk-2 to have sent the behir.
fields.Overview (Player): The original Ostekk is a brilliant tinkerer, according to Ostekk-2, and believed to have sent the mechanical behir that boarded the tyrant ship and destroyed most of its units. The ship's automaton units share his name.

bullets: Named by Ostekk-2 as the one it believed sent the behir
Called by Ostekk-2 a brilliant tinkerer

fields.Current State: Attending Sol directly — once in laughter, once in the night.
fields.Overview (Player): Beshaba is the goddess Sol serves. She answered him directly for the first time when he took a stroke of misfortune onto himself to save Boogie's jump — a woman laughed three times, and by the third he knew whose laughter it was. She has since spoken to him once in the night, unhurried and curious, about fate and whether he has truly escaped his origin.

bullets: Sol took a stroke of misfortune onto himself to save Boogie's jump, his strength dropping in a measured amount
As it left him, a woman laughed three times, and by the third he understood it was Beshaba
Gregory and Bartholomew saw a hair-thin arc of black lightning flicker out of Sol and back
Visited Sol again in the night, unhurried and curious, asking why he embraced chaos rather than fled it
Told him it had had his curiosity before but now had his attention, asked whether he was certain he had escaped where he came from, and said fate could still be wielded
